# task-66859c98: fill enclosed cavities

## Rule
The grid contains an outline/structure in a foreground color on a uniform background. Fill the enclosed empty cells (the background-colored cavities fully bounded by the structure) with color 4. Preserve all existing foreground and background cells outside those cavities. Cavity widths can exceed one cell; fill the entire cavity, not merely its centerline.

## Evidence from a solved recurrence
One demo used background 9 and outline 6. The outline bounded two vertical one-cell-wide cavities; the output changed only those cavity cells to 4. The accepted test used background 1 and outline 9; its structure bounded a 3x3 cavity (rows 4–6, columns 9–11 in zero-based coordinates), and the accepted output filled all nine cells with 4. Thus identify the interior by enclosure, independently of which palette colors serve as background and outline; the fill color is 4.

## Validation
Keep grid dimensions unchanged. Replace only enclosed background cells, and validate row widths and exact output serialization before submitting."
}
